# externs-phpstubs

> Read-only Kotlin lookup of PHP builtins: one `BuiltinRecord` per function, class, method, constant, class constant, property, or predefined variable, merging the generated set, the value rules, psalm's taint data, and the taint rules into the signature in force plus every fact, each tagged with its argument condition, in one canonical vocabulary.

`PhpStubs` is the entry point: its companion is the lookup over the bundled sets; `PhpStubs.with(...)` builds a lookup that also mounts consumer sets. Lookup names go through the commons-phpmodels subject creators: functions, classes, and methods fold case and drop a leading `\`; constants keep their case.

## Instructions for Agents

- Call `PhpStubs.function(name)`, `clazz(name)`, `method("Owner::name")` or `method(owner, name)`, `constant(name)`, `classConstant(...)`, `property(...)`, `variable("$name")`, or `record(subject)`; each returns a `BuiltinRecord<…>?`. A name that is not a spelling of the kind raises `IllegalArgumentException`; an unknown name returns `null`.
- `BuiltinRecord` holds `subject`, `extension: String?` (null when no generated set declares the subject), `signature: SignatureInfo?`, and the fact lists `returns`, `flows`, `sourceFacts`, `sinkFacts`, `sanitizerFacts`, `throws`. Read signatures through the typed accessors `callableSignature`, `classSignature`, `typedSignature`, `propertySignature`.
- A `ThrowsFact` with empty `classes` states the call throws none; an empty `throws` list asserts nothing about throws.
- Existence of a declaration is `signature != null`. A taint-only function or a predefined variable is a record without a signature.
- Every fact carries `owner` and `condition: ArgPattern?`. Match `condition` against the call's arguments with `ArgPattern.matches(List<IPrimitiveVal?>)`; `null` (undecidable) is the consumer's rule to apply. The record ranks nothing.
- Taint facts speak the canonical vocabulary only: `VulnType` (`sqli`, `cmdi`, `codei`, `xss`, `headeri`, `ssrf`, `pathtrav`, `fileinc`, `deser`, `callablei`, `ldapi`, `xpathi`, `schemei`) and `SourceKind` (`user-input`, `external-input`, `server-path`). No psalm name survives the merge.
- Enumerate with `PhpStubs.functions`, `classes`, `methods`, `constants`, `classConstants`, `properties`, `variables` (records) or `sinkFacts`, `sourceFacts`, `sanitizerFacts`, `flows`, `returns`, `throws` (facts); a match looser than exact is your filter over an enumeration.
- The merge keeps the entry in force per (subject, condition, unit); manual sets outrank generated ones, later position wins among equal ranks, and a unit is replaced whole. Mount order: `models/`, `value-rules/`, `vocabulary/`, `taint/`, `taint-rules/`.
- `PhpStubs.with(Path)` / `with("/classpath/root/")` / `PhpStubs + root` mounts consumer sets after the bundled ones; a set without `provenance.yaml` is manual. The bundled lookup is unchanged.
- Every bundled set also loads alone through `DocumentSetLoader.load(StubResources.opener(root), context, mapping)`; `StubResources.VOCABULARY` and `StubResources.PSALM_MAPPING` give the context and mapping the taint sets need.
- Errors: `StubIndexNotFoundException` (absent manifest or document), `StubIndexInvalidException` (malformed set, generated-set rule, conditional signature, bundled set without provenance).

## API Reference

- [Stubs API](llms/stubs.md): `BuiltinLookup`, `PhpStubs`, `BuiltinRecord`, facts, `VulnType`, `SourceKind`, `StubResources`.
